name: toggle
title: Toggle
blurb: Pressable button that can be toggled on or off with size and style variants.
description: Toggle button built on Radix UI with CVA variants for size (sm, default, lg) and style (default, outline). Shows active state with accent color.
use_when: Building toolbar buttons, text formatting controls, or any on/off button that needs visual feedback.
avoid_when: Binary choices where a switch is more appropriate. Use radio buttons or checkboxes for multi-option groups.
a11y: Built on Radix UI Toggle with full keyboard support, aria-pressed, and focus-visible indicators.
